newsitem.title: QATAR: Bank shares lift Qatar stock market.
newsitem.headline: Bank shares lift Qatar stock market.

text.p: Qatar stock market ended the week to Thursday higher on the back of sharp gains in Qatar National Bank's share price, dealers said.
The Commercial Bank of Qatar 17-share index closed about three points higher at 148.31 from 145.24 points a week earlier.
QNB, whose shares account for about one third of total market capitalisation, closed 36 riyals higher at 651 riyals from 615 riyals the previous week.
Dealers attributed the sharp rise in QNB share price to continued strong performance by the 50 percent government-owned bank.
Some 8,770 shares worth 1.27 million riyals ($349,000) were traded in the week with bank shares accounting for 64 percent of trading value.
Qatar Commercial Bank was among major gainers ending the week 10 riyals higher at 370 riyals from 360 riyals last week. Qatar Cement closed at 355 riyals from 352 riyals.
Qatar Islamic Bank ended the week 9.75 riyals lower at 175 riyals and Qatar International Bank lost five riyals to 105 riyals.
Qatar Leisure and Qatar Industrial Manufacturing Company lost one riyal each to 51 riyals and 68 riyals respectively.
